keyFindings.description: Security[secret]: fold_publish checks out ref: needs.fold_build.outputs.base and runs release-push.sh from that checkout with DEPLOY_KEY and GH_TOKEN. The build job is the untrusted half (it runs changie), and push-fold's 40-hex/HEAD==base checks live in the script just checked out, so they check themselves; actions/checkout fetches any reachable sha (fork PR heads under refs/pull/* included). Fix: check out github.sha in both jobs, pass BASE: github.sha, drop the base output, correct the :127 comment.

fold-plan silently skips every entry under .changes/unreleased/ that is not a regular *.yaml blob directly in it (reproduced: unreleased/sjawhar/fix-thing.yaml and INFRA-1-a.yml print nothing, exit 0), and AGENTS.md:147's 'use the branch name in place of the key' produces exactly such a subdirectory for a branch name with '/'. An entry is lost with no signal. Fix: fail naming each such entry, as the plan treats a malformed fragment, and say '/' becomes '-' in AGENTS.md.

release-push.sh stays exempt wholesale while this PR adds fold-notes, a release-push.sh subcommand that runs changie; a 'release-push.sh fold-notes' step in fold_publish passes the check (deep-review ran it). Fix: treat 'release-push.sh fold-notes' as dependency code, with a test case.
push-fold is described as using 'git, jq and gh only' here and at changelog-fold.yaml:24,126; it calls no jq (awk, sed, grep, tr, cut, find, sort).
check_hand_over, now shared, sets trap ... EXIT, replacing any EXIT trap set before it (deploy_key_env's at :320); safe today only by call order.
